name: slide-agent-vscode
description: Create, edit, render, and validate distinctive editable PowerPoint presentations with any AI model.

commands.title: Slide Agent: Create from Current Brief

slideAgent.cliPath.description: Optional custom path to the Slide Agent CLI. When empty, the extension uses the managed launcher under ~/.local/bin.

slideAgent.autoInstall.description: Automatically install or update the matching Slide Agent engine and agent skills once per extension version.

slideAgent.defaultOutputDirectory.description: Workspace-relative directory used by the save dialog.

slideAgent.openAfterCreate.description: Open the generated PowerPoint with the operating system after successful creation.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Slide Agent
walkthroughs.description: Create fully editable, AI-directed PowerPoint presentations in minutes.

steps.title: Install the engine
steps.description:
One command sets up the CLI, MCP server, and agent skills in your user directory.
[Install or Update](command:slideAgent.install)

steps.title: Create a presentation
steps.description:
Describe the deck; the AI model you choose directs the design.
[Create Presentation](command:slideAgent.create)

steps.title: Use it from AI chats
steps.description: Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI all get the same skill.

steps.description:
Diagnose the installation and optional preview tools.
[Check Installation](command:slideAgent.doctor)
